title: Q-CRIT-PUBLIC-STAGE: serve the stage the system reads for itself on ultrastable.io
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** BOOT-KNOWS-1 merged
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::/api/v1/ignition
**Status:** open

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=site/worker.js
code-anchor: https://tick.internal/pulse/watch

The tick reads its own stage (ignition_log; live at 2026-11-15 19:40:16: stage ticking, blocked at looping, k_eff 0.071) but the tick Worker has no public route and GET https://ultrastable.io/api/v1/ignition answers not found. The site Worker already calls the tick through the TICK service binding (/pulse/watch): add GET /api/v1/ignition and a row on /live that return the tick's readIgnition and readPulse through the same binding, with the time of the reading, and answer 503 with code stale_reading when the newest tick is older than two intervals, so a stopped tick cannot show its last stage.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:site/worker.js::/api/v1/ignition
